So follow the merge instructions on the signs, and enter the work zone at a speed that lets you handle traffic that has slowed or stopped. Drivers sometimes cut in front of a truck or pull out ahead of one, assuming it can stop as quickly as a car. A car at fifty-five can stop in about one hundred thirty to one hundred forty feet, but a fully loaded tractor-trailer with hot brakes can need more than four hundred feet.
